meta.title: Demli - voice, screen share and chat for your friend group
meta.description: Demli is a private voice, screen-share and chat app for small friend groups. Windows and Android apps, plus a browser client.

hero.title: A calm place for your friend group.
hero.lead: Voice channels, screen sharing, video calls and chat. It runs on our own server, and there are no ads.

voice.title: Voice first
voice.body: Voice channels and one-to-one calls. Rooms recover on their own after a dropped connection, and a third person can join a call without it cutting out.
voice.note: Per-person volume, device picking, call history.

share.title: Screen and camera
share.body: Share a screen or a camera, focus one stream to fill the window, and set the quality yourself.

chat.title: Chat that keeps up
chat.body: Messages, files, search, mentions and an unread line. The same on every device you use.

download.title: Get the app
download.lead: Windows and Android have native apps. Everything else runs in the browser.
download.soon: There is no macOS or iPhone app. Demli runs in the browser on both.

windows.name: Windows
windows.note: An installer that keeps itself up to date.

android.name: Android
android.note: APK with a built-in updater. Not on Google Play.
